summary: Iteration 54 double-header fix verified. LayoutContext + useInLayout() correctly suppresses MarketingHeader when nested inside the authenticated Layout. All 7 AI tool routes show exactly 1 header (Layout's) when logged in as cathy@example.com, and exactly 1 MarketingHeader when anonymous. Landing /, /app dashboard, and mobile (375x812) all show a single header as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is clean and minimal: LayoutContext.js (14 lines) + Layout.jsx wraps tree in Provider (value={inLayout:true}) + MarketingHeader returns null when inLayout is true. Default context value {inLayout:false} ensures the marketing routes (which do not mount Layout) continue rendering MarketingHeader normally — verified on / for both anonymous and logged-in cathy.

Minor (non-blocking): Layout's <header> element does not have a data-testid attribute. Consider adding data-testid="layout-header" to make future header-count assertions more semantic. The MarketingHeader already has data-testid="marketing-header".

test_evidence.logged_in_landing_/: headers=1, marketing=true (Layout not mounted on marketing routes — correct)
test_evidence.mobile_375x812_/ai-tools/budget-calculat: headers=1, mobile-bottom-nav present, no horizontal scroll

context_for_next_testing_agent: LayoutContext-driven header suppression is working as designed. If new pages that mount Layout are added (e.g., new /settings/* or /ai-tools/* routes), they automatically inherit the inLayout:true signal and any MarketingHeader they render will be hidden — no per-page changes needed. Pattern is robust against future expansion.
